rows.contract: Host detects visual stream envelopes using accepted tokens `visualize(title=…)`, `@@@VIZ-START`, and `@@@VIZ-END`, then feeds sanitized progressive fragments into the sandboxed visual-module card over PM-controlled postMessage; iframe code never scans parent DOM.
acceptance_criteria: Visual envelopes route to inline visual module, not Markdown code fences.
Tool calls, reasoning, code_execution, and code fences do not falsely trigger visual capture.
Stream gaps surface explicit degraded/fallback state.

rows.contract: Streaming render uses safe-cut partial HTML parsing, append-only reconciliation, serialized script execution, preservation of script-populated containers, TreeWalker exclusions, marker false-positive avoidance, guarded fallback loops, and zero-flicker finalization.
acceptance_criteria: No flicker/remount of chart canvases or SVGs during finalization.
Final stream state matches persisted/reloaded view.
negative_constraints: Do not remount existing chart canvases/SVGs during finalization.
Do not replace live script-populated containers.
Do not silently drop stream gaps.

mapping.toast: host-local localized visualizer feedback only; not Slack/Discord/webhook notification delivery
mapping.saveState: PM-managed per-message visual-state output; not parent localStorage
mapping.loadState: PM-managed per-message visual-state lookup with supplied fallback on miss/denial/corruption

acceptance_criteria: copyText/toast/saveState/loadState all resolve through PM bridge authority.
Alias use never creates a second command payload language.

owner_boundary_for_compile.default: copyText, toast, saveState, and loadState are visualizer host API aliases, not UICommand rows.
owner_boundary_for_compile.ui_command_exception: Create UI_Command_Catalog and Wiring_Matrix rows only if a user-visible control dispatches outside the iframe host bridge.

alias_contracts.toast: host-local localized visualizer feedback only; not Slack/Discord/webhook notification delivery
alias_contracts.saveState: PM-managed per-message visual-state output; not parent localStorage
alias_contracts.loadState: PM-managed per-message visual-state lookup with supplied fallback on miss/denial/corruption

negative_constraints: No notification delivery semantics for visualizer toast.

rows.contract: Add PM-native v2 defaults for 9 color ramps, data-accent, pre-styled bare button/input/textarea/select/table/details/summary/dl[data-layout="grid"], SVG utility classes, aria-invalid="true", and :focus-visible.
negative_constraints: Do not copy Open WebUI CSS wholesale.
Audio chime remains optional, user-controlled, and off by default.

token_recipe_for_compile.owner_binding: Final GUI theme owner must bind these variables to PM-owned theme tokens or explicit generated-for-PM values before implementation. Implementation must not invent ramp names or values locally.

rows.policy: Default allowlist remains empty. Each candidate requires exact package name, exact pinned version, bundled asset ref, SHA-256/SRI integrity record, artifact metadata declaration, license/security review, performance budget, rendering capability scope, fallback behavior, upgrade/removal policy, and owner approval path before execution.
deferred: Wavesurfer unless PM defines explicit audio or waveform visualization use cases

rows.contract: Persist source fragment, title/type/version, render config, approved bridge metadata, PM-managed state outputs, and visible fallback/error state. Reload re-renders from persisted source/config/state; screenshot or snapshot fallback is used only when re-render is impractical.
boundaries: Active stream chunks are ephemeral/session-bounded until committed.
Logs record metadata/refs, not arbitrary DOM contents, secrets, or full visual payloads unless export profile permits.

validation_rows: streaming marker parse/progressive render/finalize with false-positive fixtures
incremental reconciliation no flicker/no remount/serialized scripts
bridge alias behavior and question-flow sendPrompt omission
sandbox/network denial for allow-same-origin, parent.document, parent localStorage, CDN, dynamic import, unvetted network
library allowlist denial/fallback and allowed pinned-library execution
reload/export reconstruction and no state leakage
localized ready/copy/error feedback and audio-off default
negative_constraints: Do not call visualizer v2 ready without both visual UX and security-boundary tests.
